shellCommands.command: ls -la && cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git ls-files | head -50; head -c 600 package-lock.json

cat index.html src/*.tsx src/vite-env.d.ts tsconfig.json vite.config.ts .gitignore; ls -R __agent_eval__ | head; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui; cat node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json | grep '"version"'

ls node_modules | grep -iE "dnd|table|navigation|sortable|tanstack"; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons | head -3; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; grep -n '"@gravity-ui/icons"' package.json node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/package.json

ls node_modules/@tanstack; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/Table/hoc; grep -n '"version"' node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/package.json; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/uikit/build/esm/components/layout
timeout 20 npm view @gravity-ui/table version 2>&1 | tail -2
for p in @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/navigation; do echo == $p; npm view $p version peerDependencies dependencies --json 2>&1 | head -40; done

npm install @gravity-ui/navigation @gravity-ui/table @gravity-ui/icons @dnd-kit/core @dnd-kit/sortable @bem-react/classname lodash @gravity-ui/i18n 2>&1 | tail -8; grep -A14 '"dependencies"' package.json

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui && ls table/build/esm table/build/esm/components table/build/esm/hooks 2>/dev/null | head -60; cat table/build/esm/index.d.ts; cat table/build/esm/hooks/useTable/useTable.d.ts 2>/dev/null | head -40
ls navigation/build/esm/components | tr '\n' ' '; cat navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts | head -120

sed -n 120,220p navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/types.d.ts; cat navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader/AsideHeader.d.ts | head; cat navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; ls navigation/build/esm/components/AsideHeader; ls navigation/build/esm/ ; grep -n "AsideHeader\|Content\|FooterItem" navigation/build/esm/index.d.ts

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && cat components/Table/Table.d.ts components/Table/types.d.ts hooks/useTable/*.d.ts types/base.d.ts constants/index.d.ts components/ColumnReorderingProvider/*.d.ts components/BaseTable/BaseTable.d.ts 2>&1 | head -300

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table && ls; cat build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.d.ts | sed -n 1,80p; cat build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.d.ts; grep -rn "getIsGrouped\|isGrouped\|getIsGroupHeaderRow" build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/*.js | head -20; cat build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.d.ts

grep -n -i "group\|reorder\|selection" README.md | head -50; cat build/esm/components/BaseRow/BaseRow.js | sed -n 8,80p; cat build/esm/components/BaseGroupHeader/BaseGroupHeader.js; cat build/esm/constants/selectionColumn.js

sed -n 255,350p README.md; grep -n -i "column.*reorder\|ColumnReorderingProvider" README.md | head; cat build/esm/tanstack.d.ts | head -5; sed -n 1,60p build/esm/hooks/useTable/useTable.js 2>/dev/null || ls build/esm/hooks

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm && cat hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.d.ts; grep -rn "getIsGroupHeaderRow" --include=*.js . | grep -v "BaseRow.js\|BaseTable.js" | head; sed -n 450,480p ../../README.md

cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation && grep -n '"exports"' -A25 package.json | head -40; ls build/ ; grep -n "RenderContentType" -B2 -A8 build/esm/components/Content/*.d.ts | head -30; grep -rn "AsideHeader\b" build/esm/components/index.d.ts
ls build/docs | head; grep -n "main\|module\|types\|sideEffects" package.json | head; ls build/esm/components/AsideHeader/__stories__ | head; ls build/esm/components/AsideHeader/components
cd /home/sandbox/workspace/node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/docs && ls components; cat components/AsideHeader* 2>/dev/null | head -150 || find . -iname "*aside*" | head

cd /home/sandbox/workspace && ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/icons/ | grep -E "^(House|Persons|ShoppingCart|Gear|Cubes3|Box)\.js$"; grep -n "interface LogoProps" -A22 node_modules/@gravity-ui/navigation/build/esm/components/types.d.ts; grep -rn "enableColumnReordering" node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm --include=*.js | head -5; ls node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/components/ColumnReorderingProvider
grep -n '"exports"' -A22 node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/package.json; sed -n 1,30p node_modules/@gravity-ui/table/build/esm/hooks/useRowSelectionFixedHandler.js
npm run build 2>&1 | tail -30

rm -rf dist; which chromium chromium-browser google-chrome 2>&1 | head -3; ls ~/.cache/ms-playwright 2>&1 | head; ls node_modules | grep -i -E "playwright|puppeteer|jsdom|happy-dom"; cat __agent_eval__/run.mjs | head -30

python3 - <<'EOF'
p='src/App.tsx'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("      menuItems={menuItems}\n","      menuItems={menuItems}\n      menuOverflow=\"scroll\"\n",1)
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
sed -i "s/expect(container.textContent).toContain(t)/expect(container.querySelector('aside, [class*=aside]')!.textContent).toContain(t)/" src/smoke.test.tsx
npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | cut -c1-400 | head -40
npx vitest run -c vitest.smoke.config.ts 2>&1 | grep -v "^$" | cut -c1-300 | head -40

rm -f src/smoke.test.tsx src/smoke2.test.tsx vitest.smoke.config.ts && diff <(grep -A12 '"dependencies"' package.json) <(grep -A12 '"dependencies"' /tmp/pkg.bak) && echo "package.json unchanged by test deps"; grep -c jsdom package.json; printf 'dist/\n' >> .gitignore; npm run build 2>&1 | grep -E "error|built|✓"; rm -rf dist; git status --short
